gold: Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension
e7_s4_rationale: Vitreous biopsy showed hypercellular sample with astrocytic neoplasm and immunohistochemistry positive for glial fibrillary acid protein and mutant IDH-1 protein, which are characteristic of glioblastoma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Bevacizumab-Associated Optic Neuropathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: While bevacizumab is a risk factor, the biopsy results indicate a neoplastic process

e7_s4_rejected.label: Durvalumab-Associated Optic Neuropathy
e7_s4_rejected.why: Similar to bevacizumab, durvalumab is a risk factor but the biopsy results suggest a primary neoplastic process

e7_s4_rejected.label: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The biopsy and immunohistochemistry results are not consistent with lymphoma

e7_s4_rejected.label: Optic Disc Edema
e7_s4_rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy results indicate a more complex and malignant process than simple optic disc edema
